ErrorCode.Message: [ERR1247] Drawing [Drawing] Management Pack version in SCOM ([Version]) is inconsistent with the Drawing Set [Version]
ErrorCode.Cause: The Management Pack loaded into SCOM is different to what is required by the Drawing Set
ErrorCode.Resolution: Update the Management Pack

ErrorCode.Message: [ERR1248] A Business Application for [Drawing] (Drawing) was not specified
ErrorCode.Cause: The Focused Application Name for the specified Drawing was not found
ErrorCode.Resolution: Update the Management Drawing, setting the Application Name

ErrorCode.Message: [ERR1249] [Business Application] (Business Application): Could not load additional data
ErrorCode.Cause: The Get Business Application Details Query did not return valid data for this Business Application
ErrorCode.Resolution: Check the status of the SQL Server. If this error does not reoccur, reload the information but check the frequency, and advise Technical Support as necessary

ErrorCode.Message: [ERR1250] [Server] (Server) Stream is set to 'B' and Virtual is set to 'false' which is an invalid combination
ErrorCode.Cause: A physical Server cannot be recovered using tools for Virtual machines
ErrorCode.Resolution: Set the Stream for the Server as appropriate

ErrorCode.Message: [ERR251] A Business Application for the Drawing [Drawing] was not found
ErrorCode.Cause: There was a problem loading the Drawing Set
ErrorCode.Resolution: Ensure the Drawing Set is correct

ErrorCode.Message: [ERR1252] [Business Application] (Business Application): Could not load data for property 'Work Instruction Name'
ErrorCode.Cause: The Get Business Application Details Query did not return valid data for Property 'Work Instruction Name'
ErrorCode.Resolution: Check the Get Business Application Details query is correct

ErrorCode.Message: [ERR1253] [Business Application] (Business Application) has at least one component that is recovered after it ([Business Application])! This will cause the Runbook to be incorrect!
ErrorCode.Cause: Components of a Business Application must be recovered before the Application
ErrorCode.Resolution: Review all components of the Business Application and ensure the Tier of each Component Business Application is correct
